background.description: Full-page illustration of a sunny school scene. Sky is light blue with white cumulus clouds at the top; the lower page is a warm sand-coloured paved ground. The page's scene is drawn in a 3D-style cartoon (soft lighting, realistic-looking shading).
background.rebuild_notes: No background crop saved: the sky and sand ground contain printed text (title in the sky, three body lines on the sand), so no text-free crop exists. Sky: top ~270 px of the page, blue gradient to pale near horizon, clouds at left top and right top, one small cloud near the flag. Ground: sand/peach #E8C49A-like flat tone with soft shadows under the children and the gates. Grass lawn sits between the building and the ground (y about 1100-1300 at display scale, roughly 1800-2100 px original). Left and right brick pillar bases are brick red #A4553A with cream plaster above.

text_blocks.text: এটা আমাদের স্কুল। আমাদের স্কুল ভালো।
স্কুলের মাঠ সুন্দর। আমি ছাত্র। নুহা ছাত্রী।
আমরা স্কুলে যাই। স্যার আমাদের পড়ান।

images.description: A tall silver-grey flagpole with a Bangladesh flag: green field with a red disc, flying to the right. Pole has a small gold finial at the top.
images.purpose: Stands in the middle of the scene as the focal point above the courtyard
images.style: 3D cartoon render, soft shading, slight highlight on the pole
images.rebuild_notes: Pole is thin (about 14 px wide original). Flag is about 150 by 110 px display, red disc about 40 percent of flag height and centred slightly left of middle. Crop includes a small piece of sky and building behind the pole; the pole base sits in a round flower bed (included at the bottom edge).

images.description: Two young children seen from behind, walking away towards the school gate. Left child: short black hair, white shirt, blue backpack with a gold diamond badge, navy trousers, white shoes. Right child: white headscarf, white long-sleeved top, navy skirt, white socks, black shoes, pink backpack with a floral pattern and a gold diamond badge.
images.purpose: The two main characters of the scene, walking into the school
images.style: 3D cartoon render, soft lighting, cast shadows on the ground
images.rebuild_notes: Front-most figures. Ground shadows under both children are included at the bottom of the crop. Backpack straps and the gold diamond badges are small (about 40 px). Pink backpack has a floral print in pale pink and green.

images.description: Children's playground set: a red slide with a yellow handrail, a blue metal frame with two swings, and a red and yellow canopy on the top of the slide.
images.purpose: Shows the play area on the right of the school grounds
images.rebuild_notes: Blue frame: two upright poles and a crossbar, two swing seats hanging on chains. Red slide is angled to the lower right. Crop includes a few green bushes at the base.

images.description: Left school gate: a tall brown metal gate with vertical bars, hinged to a cream plaster pillar with a brick-red lower section. Gate is opened outwards.
images.purpose: Frames the school entrance on the left
images.style: 3D cartoon render, dark metal bars with light edge highlights
images.rebuild_notes: Gate has about 9 vertical bars and two horizontal rails. Bottom of the crop is at the paved ground level. The crop does not include the left pillar, which is part of the building scene (i7).

images.description: Right school gate: a tall brown metal gate with vertical bars, hinged to a cream plaster pillar with a brick-red lower section. Gate is opened outwards.
images.purpose: Frames the school entrance on the right
images.style: 3D cartoon render, dark metal bars with light edge highlights
images.rebuild_notes: Mirror of i4: same bar count and rails. The crop does not include the right pillar.

images.description: Three children in white shirts and navy shorts on a green lawn: two run on the left, one stands kicking, and a black-and-white football lies on the grass in front of them.
images.purpose: Shows other pupils playing football on the field behind the children
images.style: 3D cartoon render, small figures, soft shadows
images.rebuild_notes: Figures are about 80 px tall at this scale. Ball is about 30 px diameter with black pentagons. Crop includes grass and a small patch of the lawn border at the bottom.

images.description: The left and centre part of the two-storey school building: cream plaster walls, flat roof with a deep overhang, columns, windows with brown frames, balconies with railings, brown wooden doors, blue plinth at the base, a small green tree and shrubs in front.
images.purpose: Forms the back wall of the school courtyard
images.rebuild_notes: Contains the flagpole base area on its right edge (the flagpole i1 is saved separately, so the crop only includes its base shadow). Left pillar and the top of the left gate (i4) sit on the left edge of this crop. The crop does not include the title text, which is in the sky above this crop. Shrubs and tree in front of the building are included.

images.description: The right part of the school building: cream walls, a row of windows with blue glass, brown doors, white railings on the balconies, and a blue plinth at the base.
images.purpose: Forms the back wall of the school courtyard on the right side
images.rebuild_notes: Crop starts just right of the flagpole. Bottom edge is at the lawn line. Right edge touches the right gate pillar (i5 is saved separately).

doubts: t1: font name and size are guesses from the image; box edges estimated by eye from a downscaled view (display 1559x2000 mapped to 2550x3270 by x1.64)
t2-t4: body lines are placed as one block per line; font name and size are guesses
Page size taken from the original image dimensions (2550x3270); confirm against pages/page-003.png if the saved PNG differs
No background crop: the sky and sand ground both contain printed text, so bg.png cannot be made without text. image_file is null and the scene is described in rebuild_notes instead.
i1 (flag pole) and i7/i8 (building) touch: a small piece of building is inside the flagpole box and the base of the flagpole sits on the building crop edge. Check the seam.
i4/i5 (gates) and i7/i8 (building) touch at the top edge of the gates: the pillars sit in the building crops. Pillars are in i7 (left) and the right pillar is partly in i8.
Box edges are estimated by eye from a downscaled view (display 1559x2000 mapped to 2550x3270 by x1.64). Confirm the crop edges against the page image; crops may be a few px short or long.
The scene is one connected illustration split into objects. Some pixels are shared between neighbouring crops (lawn, grass, shadows). This is a deliberate choice so no object is cut in half.
